content.title: ‘Celebrity Jeopardy!’ Announces Star-Studded Cast for ‘All-Star’ Season - IMDb
content.text: ‘Celebrity Jeopardy!’ Announces Star-Studded Cast for ‘All-Star’ SeasonThe category is.. stars and more stars. If the contestants on the upcoming season of Celebrity Jeopardy! look familiar to you, it’s because they’ve played the game before. The game show announced the line-up for the All-Star season, which is technically its fourth season. The star-studded celebrities include the past three winners, as well as fan-favorites. In a trailer for the cast announcement, host Ken Jennings said, “Jeopardy! goes Hollywood. Our brightest stars are all back.” The third season of the show ended with stand-up comic and television host W. Kamau Bell taking home $1,000,000 for the non-profit organization DonorsChoose.
